about.title: About me
about.lead: I'm a frontend developer based in Lima, Peru, with about two years of experience building applications with React, React Native and Next.js. I work to make what I deliver easy to use today and easy to modify in six months: clean code, TypeScript and code review as part of the process, not as an extra.

values.performanceText: I optimize rendering and application state so it loads and responds smoothly. In a mobile app, I helped reduce startup time from about 5 s to about 2 s.
values.architectureText: I separate responsibilities into clear layers so the project remains easy to understand and expand as it grows.
values.collaborationTitle: I work with you and your team
values.collaborationText: I integrate REST APIs, coordinate endpoint design with backend and participate in code reviews, so what I deliver fits with the rest of your product.
